blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Three individuals were arrested after police implemented a search warrant in Barangay Madupayas, Badoc, Ilocos Norte, on Thursday, Nov. 19, resulting in the seizure of several firearms, ammunition, a rifle grenade and suspected illegal drugs. The operation was carried out by personnel from the Provincial Intelligence Unit, Provincial Investigation and Detective Management Unit, Badoc Municipal Police Station, 2nd Provincial Mobile Force Company and other law enforcement partners. The search warrant was issued in connection with an alleged violation of Republic Act No. 10591, or the Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act. Among the recovered items were […]...
